categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Level-1 / level-2 categories with bilingual names; assign products to level-2 (e.g. Toyota › Camry).
categories.name: Name
categories.bilingualHint: Chinese name appears when the site is in 中文; English name when in English.
categories.twoLevelHint: Leave parent empty for level-1 (e.g. Toyota). Pick a parent for level-2 (e.g. Camry under Toyota). Codes must be globally unique.
categories.parentHint: Only level-2 needs a parent; leave empty for level-1
categories.hasChildrenParentLocked: This category has children and must stay level-1.
categories.keywordPh: Filter by Chinese/English name or code

tags.title: Product tags
tags.subtitle: Bilingual tag names; the storefront shows the label for the shopper’s language. “Show on storefront” controls filters and product chips.
tags.showOnStorefrontHint: When off, the tag is hidden from catalog filters and product pages; products may still be tagged for admin/marketing use.
tags.keywordPh: Filter by code or Chinese/English name
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete this tag and remove it from all products?

skuSpecs.title: SKU specifications
skuSpecs.subtitle: One-to-many: each dimension (e.g. Color, Size) has its own values. Black/White belong to Color only; S/M/L belong to Size only.
skuSpecs.modelDesc: Define a dimension with code + name (e.g. COLOR + Color). Add multiple values under it, each with code + name (e.g. BLACK + Black). The SKU matrix only shows values for the dimension you pick.
skuSpecs.expandHint: The table is for overview only. Click Edit to manage a dimension and its values in a dialog, or use the top-right button to create a dimension with multiple values.
skuSpecs.dimPairHint: Dimension code for the system (e.g. SIZE); dimension name shown in the matrix (e.g. Size).
skuSpecs.valueLinesHint: Each value needs code + name; values belong only to the dimension above.
skuSpecs.valuesPanelDesc: Values here apply only to this dimension, not to others in the list.
skuSpecs.needAtLeastOneValue: Add at least one value (code + name)
skuSpecs.keywordPh: Filter by dimension code or name
skuSpecs.batchModalHint: Add multiple values for one dimension. Code and name are separate fields (no colon).
skuSpecs.batchEmpty: Enter at least one complete value row
skuSpecs.deleteDimConfirm: Delete this dimension and all its values?
skuSpecs.editDimValuesHint: Add, edit, or delete values below. Click OK to save only the dimension name, sort order, and active status.

translationCatalog.title: UI copy management
translationCatalog.subtitle: Edit storefront and admin UI strings by locale. Changes take effect after reload; import/export JSON for backup or bulk edits.
translationCatalog.notSeeded: No catalog in database — click “Seed from bundle” or import JSON.
translationCatalog.deleteConfirm: Delete this locale catalog from the database? The storefront will fall back to bundled JSON.

translation.title: Translation settings
translation.subtitle: Configure DeepL for admin “translate” actions and i18n sync. If VOYAGE_I18N_API_KEY is set in the environment, it overrides the key stored here.
translation.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the existing key
translation.envKeyActiveHint: VOYAGE_I18N_API_KEY in the process environment overrides the key saved on this page.

exchangeRates.title: Exchange rates
exchangeRates.subtitle: Products are priced in USD; the storefront shows converted amounts by locale. Set global/per-currency markup and freeze windows.
exchangeRates.settingsHint: Scheduler checks every 30 minutes; external API is called only when the interval has elapsed and the currency is not frozen.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.subtitle: Coupons and threshold promotions. Tag filter: comma-separated tag codes; empty means all products.
marketing.fixedMin: Fixed discount must be greater than 0

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Registered users with membership tier and lifetime spend (updated when orders are marked paid; see backend notes on currency).
customers.preferencesPh: Buying preferences, time zone, communication style…
customers.resetPwdConfirmDesc: This will replace the current password immediately. If you leave the new password field empty, the system will use this customer's registered email as the new password (minimum 6 characters). Share the result through a secure channel.
customers.resetPwdConfirmSecondDescManual: The password you entered will be applied. This cannot be undone.
customers.resetPwdConfirmSecondDescEmail: No password was entered; the new password will be {{email}}. This cannot be undone.
customers.resetPwdResultDesc: Copy the value below and share it offline (do not use insecure channels). If you left the field empty, this is the email in plain text.
customers.resetPwdHintBody: You may leave the field empty: the new password will be this customer's email {{email}} (must be at least 6 characters; if the email is too short, enter a password manually). If you type a value, that plaintext will be used as the new password.

membershipRules.title: Membership tier rules
membershipRules.subtitle: Tier is the first active rule (ordered by threshold, highest threshold first) where lifetime paid >= threshold; otherwise NONE. Existing users' tier refreshes on the next paid order accumulation. If no active rules exist, built-in defaults apply.
membershipRules.createFail: Create failed (duplicate code, reserved NONE, etc.)
membershipRules.footer: {{n}} rule(s); table sorted by sort number.

stats.title: Dashboard
stats.subtitle: Live aggregates (no cache).
stats.revenueNote: Paid revenue sums order total_amount where payment_status is PAID; no FX conversion.

orders.title: Order management
orders.subtitle: Dictionary-driven statuses · Tabs · Logistics
orders.filterByCustomerDesc: Showing orders for {{display}} only. Close this banner to see all orders again.
orders.logisticsTrailHint: Append rows to the logistics table for this order no. Independent from the main tracking snapshot; both show in order detail.
orders.useRepairForRollback: To move back to an earlier status, fill the remark and click "Repair order".
orders.repairOnlyRollback: "Repair order" only supports rollback to an earlier configured status.
orders.statusRevertDesc: Change status from "{{from}}" to "{{to}}". Reverting may affect fulfillment records. Continue?
orders.statusFail: Update failed — check the status is allowed
orders.statusModalHint: The next status in the dictionary is pre-selected; you may change it. Use Save to move forward; for rollback, enter a remark and click Repair order.
orders.remarkPh: Remark (optional for forward; required for repair)

products.uploadTip: Thumbnail and full image are generated server-side (full = original or scaled per config).
products.coverHint: The first image is the cover in grids; use "Set as cover" or move up/down.
products.dragHint: Drag images here or click to browse (multi-select)
products.compressHint: Images above ~200KB are compressed in the browser before upload; smaller files are sent as-is.

products.categoryFieldHint: Level-2 only, shown as Parent › Child (e.g. Toyota › Camry)
products.skuMatrixHint: Multi-attribute SKUs are managed on a separate page.
products.skuMatrixCardDesc: Pick 1–10 attribute dimensions from dictionaries, generate combinations, then set price/stock; you can save edits repeatedly.
products.attrDimensionsWarning: Select at least one attribute dimension and at least one value per dimension (from PRODUCT_SKU_ATTR / PRODUCT_SKU_ATTR_VALUE).
products.skuMatrixPageSub: Configure dimensions, generate or add SKU rows, edit the table, then click Save SKU combinations.
products.skuMatrixAttrHint: Maintain dimensions and values under SKU specifications (not dictionaries). Go to
products.skuMatrixAttrDialogHint: One dimension by default; use Add dimension for more. Confirm to apply, then generate combinations on the main page.
products.skuMatrixGenerateDialogHint: Append new rows from the Cartesian product (default 3 per run). Edit codes, price, and stock in the list, then save.
products.skuMatrixNoMoreCombos: No new combinations to append (all exist or dimensions incomplete)
products.skuMatrixListHint: Edit SKU code, price, and stock in the table below, then click Save SKU combinations.
products.skuMatrixRowAdded: Row added — adjust price and stock as needed
products.skuMatrixSaved: Matrix saved. You can keep editing and save again.
products.skuMatrixMinAttrs: Configure at least one dimension with values
products.skuMatrixPriceInvalid: Every SKU sale price must be ≥ 0.01
products.skuMatrixDupComboHint: Duplicate attribute combinations — keep only one SKU per combo.

dicts.title: Dictionaries
dicts.subtitle: Centralize status codes and labels.
dicts.itemCodeHintSku: For PRODUCT_SKU_ATTR_VALUE use ATTR:VALUE, e.g. POWER:HYBRID
dicts.deleteTypeConfirm: Delete this type and all its items?
dicts.helpBody: Dictionaries are for order status, after-sales status, etc. Product SKU specs belong under SKU specifications in the sidebar.
dicts.guideGeneralIntro: For business enums (not SKU), follow these steps.
dicts.guideGeneral1: Click “New dictionary type” and enter an UPPER_SNAKE code (e.g. ORDER_STATUS) and display name.
dicts.guideGeneral2: Expand a type in the list, or click “New dictionary item”, and add item code + label.
dicts.guideGeneral3: Keep item codes stable for APIs; change item labels when you only need new wording.
dicts.guideSectionSku: 2. Example: add Power / Hybrid for SKU matrix
dicts.guideSkuMoved: SKU dimensions and values are managed under SKU specifications. Do not use PRODUCT_SKU_ATTR dictionary types here.
